senses.gloss:
फुल्ल् 1. P. (ut videtur, Denom. a फुल्ल, v. 1. फल्) se expandere,
de floribus; florescere. (Cf. gr. ϕύλλον =
फुल्ल, v. 1. फल्; lat. folium; flôs, flôris e flôv-is, a flu per
metath. e ful? sicut plôro = प्लावयामि a प्लु q. v.; anglo-sax.
blôvan florere; germ. vet. bluôn, pluôn id.; blômo,
Them. blô-mon; goth. blô-ma, Them. blô-man, flos,
suff. man = मान, gr. μενος, part. praes. med.)
